eyebrow: The same seed always reproduces the same sequence
code:
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
first = rng.random(5)

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
second = rng.random(5)

np.array_equal(first, second)
# True
caption: Give a PRNG the same seed and it produces the exact same sequence every time.

eyebrow: A deterministic sanity check for random sampling
code:
N = 10000
p = 0.5

expected_heads = N * p
print(expected_heads)
# 5000.0
caption: The right test: "sampled count close to 5000, within statistical noise" — not one exact outcome.
